note: Manistee County does not publish a county-wide zoning district layer. Zoning is administered by townships, villages and the City of Manistee. Their zoning maps are published only as static PDF maps (e.g., Arcadia Township, Marilla Township) and the city's zoning map is a viewer link with no exposed ArcGIS service. ArcGIS searches for Manistee zoning found no queryable district polygon layer (only state Natural Rivers overlay and unrelated layers). The county GIS host did not respond.
